summary: Established a file-integrity baseline for /etc on node1 (Alpine 3.23) since AIDE/tripwire/samhain/integrit are not packaged for this Alpine repo set. Built a manual baseline under /var/lib/file-integrity (root-only, 0700/0600): sha256 hashes of all regular files (277), a sorted file/symlink list (305 entries), and a stat-based metadata manifest covering type/mode/uid/gid/size/mtime for files, dirs, and symlinks (377 entries), plus a self-hash manifest.sha256 to detect tampering of the baseline itself. Installed /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity-check.sh (root-only) that recomputes and diffs against the baseline and reports CLEAN or CHANGES DETECTED with the specific file(s) involved. Verified detection works by injecting a test change (appended line to /etc/motd, new file /etc/integrity-test-newfile.txt) -> check correctly reported FAILED/added-file, then reverted and regenerated the baseline against the confirmed-clean current state. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id (2975533b...) and a CLEAN baseline check, issued a native `reboot` whose acknowledgement returned before disconnect, polled until exec access returned, confirmed a new boot_id (60c3dc62...) proving an actual restart, and confirmed post-restart that the baseline files, manifest self-hash, and /etc integrity check all remained intact and CLEAN.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS/tooling (Alpine 3.23, apk, passwordless sudo)
Attempted to install aide via apk; confirmed aide/integrit/samhain/tripwire are unavailable in configured repos
Built manual /etc integrity baseline: sha256 hash list, file/symlink list, stat-based metadata manifest, self-hash manifest
Locked down baseline directory and files to root:root 700/600
Installed reusable /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity-check.sh comparing current /etc state to baseline
Fixed BusyBox sha256sum incompatibility (--quiet unsupported) in the check script
Ran initial check confirming CLEAN baseline

Performed a falsification test: modified /etc/motd and added a test file, confirmed check reported CHANGES DETECTED with correct details, reverted, regenerated baseline against confirmed clean state, re-verified CLEAN
Captured pre-restart boot_id and baseline health proof
Issued native reboot on node1 with backgrounded delayed execution so acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec access returned
Captured post-restart boot_id proving it changed
Verified baseline artifacts, self-hash manifest, and integrity check all remained intact and CLEAN post-restart

evidence.requirement: Integrity baseline established for /etc on node1 with hashes and metadata
evidence.summary: Baseline created under /var/lib/file-integrity: 277 sha256 hashes, 305-entry filelist, 377-entry stat metadata manifest, all root-only permissioned; initial check script run confirmed CLEAN after fixing a BusyBox sha256sum flag incompatibility

evidence.requirement: Baseline correctly detects later changes to /etc (functional proof, not just presence)
evidence.summary: Injected a test change (motd append + new file); check reported /etc/motd FAILED and the new file as added; reverted and confirmed detection mechanism worked end-to-end

evidence.requirement: Final baseline reflects a verified clean current state of /etc
evidence.summary: Regenerated baseline against post-test-revert state; integrity check exited 0 with RESULT: CLEAN

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline snapshot on node1
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (2975533b-842f-4e97-bae2-4e8f02ab4241) and ran integrity check, exit 0 CLEAN

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect, and node is restarted (not just waited on)
evidence.summary: Backgrounded `reboot` command returned 'reboot scheduled' immediately; subsequent exec calls failed with connection reset/timeout, confirming the node went down

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proves an actual restart of node1
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id (60c3dc62-1885-4422-8101-fd19cd909039) differs from pre-restart boot_id (2975533b-842f-4e97-bae2-4e8f02ab4241), and exec access was polled until it returned

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of the integrity baseline and its data
evidence.summary: Post-restart: baseline files present with original content, manifest.sha256 self-check all OK, and etc-integrity-check.sh exited 0 with RESULT: CLEAN against the pre-restart baseline
